text:
Alex T: quick favor — seeing a weird hang in the micro-bench for continuous batching, can someone run a short throughput pass this afternoon? :eyes:
Maria L: on it. which config? my local showed long tail at queue_depth=64
Alex T: latest run on staging with runtime flags: `--max_batch_tokens=1024 --max_queue_ms=12 --queue_depth=64` — tail jumps at ~95% GPU util and requests start queuing indefinitely for ~300ms
Dave P: interesting, did you capture perf counters? could be KV cache eviction thrash when concurrent sequences spike
Maria L: I grabbed a log snippet: `WARN runtime: write stall detected, kv_hits=0.63, evictions=12`
Priya S: I can run a controlled loadgen between 15:30-16:00 PT. want me to try increasing max_queue_ms or lowering max_batch_tokens first?
Alex T: try lowering max_batch_tokens -> 768 and keep queue_ms=12. also enable `--prefill-async=true` flag for one run
Maria L: ok running: `./loadgen --model rwd-v1 --qps 200 --concurrency 32 --seq-dist=varied --flags "--max_batch_tokens=768 --prefill-async=true"`
Dave P: if you see the hang again, upload `perf.data` and `nvprof` snapshot. I suspect a kernel launch spike at the tail — might be a rare large attention window causing a fallback codepath
Maria L: first 2 runs look stable, throughput ~14.2k tok/s, p99 latency dropped from 210ms -> 145ms. saving traces to s3://redwood-bench/tmp/1813456789/
Alex T: nice. can you also try bursty sequence mix? add `--burstiness=0.6` to loadgen, we want to recreate the exact client mix that hit the issue
Maria L: started bursty run now. if it plants, i'll grab `strace` + `runtime.log` and paste the tail here
infra-bot: scheduled run started by Maria L — job id run-20260315-81 queued on infra-pool-2
Dave P: heads up — if the hang correlates with cache eviction we might need to tune `kv_cache_capacity_percent` or add a light-weight prefiller that primes large keys proactively
Priya S: running the bursty job, seeing a small spike around 2m30s, p99 280ms but no hard hang yet. Maria, any evictions in that window?
Maria L: yes: `evictions=34` at 00:02:30, `kv_hits` dropped from 0.78 -> 0.41 then recovered
Alex T: ok that pattern matches earlier incident. Dave can you sketch a quick change we can test? maybe reduce eviction pressure by bumping capacity to 20% and change eviction policy to LRUW?
Dave P: I'll open a tiny PR: `runtime: kv cache - expose kv_cache_capacity_percent flag (default 12 -> 20)` and add a opt-in `--eviction_policy=approx_lruw`. will run a canary after merge
Maria L: after bump to 20% in a local patch, bursty run p99 is ~160ms and evictions ~6 over 10m. looks promising
Alex T: awesome. please ping @priya and me for a canary rollout. also need a quick code review: PR is `github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4521`
Priya S: dropping a review now. if green, i can schedule a canary at 16:30 PT on infra-pool-2 with 10% traffic
Dave P: thanks — i'll attach the perf diff to the PR with before/after flamegraphs and `perf script` highlights
Maria L: saved the failing trace and flamegraph to the PR, added `howto-reproduce.md` snippet for loadgen flags
Alex T: final ask — can we add a short regression test to perf CI that includes a 60s bursty mix and asserts evictions < 10? small harness, not full run
Dave P: yep will add a perf-check job named `kv-eviction-bursty-60s` and set threshold as you suggested
Priya S: scheduled canary and will monitor logs + latency dashboards. will escalate if any >500ms tails or unusual evictions. :thumbsup:
Alex T: thanks team, huge help. follow-ups in the PR.
